tools.name: rf_smith_transform
tools.description: Free tier: Deterministic Smith-chart conversions (Z, Y, Gamma, VSWR) and RLC equivalents. Supply exactly one of z, y, gamma, gamma_polar, or vswr_phase.

tools.name: rf_link_budget
tools.description: Free tier: Friis FSPL, EIRP/ERP, 290K thermal noise floor, SNR, Fresnel radius, and max range. Supply tx_gain_dbi or tx_gain_dbd.

tools.name: rf_match_network
tools.description: Metered ($0.01): L/Pi/T impedance matching, E12-E96 snapping, finite-Q loss, and tolerance corner VSWR.

tools.name: rf_txline
tools.description: Metered ($0.005): Lossless and lossy transmission-line Z_in, Gamma_in, VSWR_in, and quarter-wave Z0. Supply length_m or electrical_deg.

tools.name: rf_touchstone_analyze
tools.description: Metered ($0.015): IEEE Touchstone v1.0 .s1p/.s2p analysis, uniform single-pass phase rotation S_ij*exp(+j*2*pi*f*delay_ps*1e-12) across s11/s21/s12/s22 (use delay_ps=2*tau for 1-port round-trip VNA extension), passbands, and Rollett K/stability.

tools.name: rf_fcc_compliance
tools.description: Metered ($0.02): 47 CFR Part 15 limits. Mode 'radiated' requires standard + points[1..4096]; 'conducted' requires standard + points[1..4096]; 'ism-comb' requires band + fundamental_hz (+ optional clocks_hz[<=64]).
